extracted.intended_audience: PR professionals, corporate communications teams, marketers, and media relations specialists
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for distributing press releases to maximize reach, credibility, engagement, and measurable impact using PR Newswire's services and platform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reach & Visibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Reach journalist and influencer audiences across the world – or just down the street. PR Newswire claims reach in 170+ countries, 40+ languages, 200,000+ journalists & influencers, 8,000+ websites globally and 2.1 million social media followers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a distributor with broad geographic, language, and channel coverage to maximize the number of potential viewers and pickup opportunities; choose distribution scale appropriate to your target markets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credibility & Reputation of Distributor
rubrics_metrics.description: All over the world, editors, journalists and influencers know that when something comes from PR Newswire, it’s credible, reliable and worth reading.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sending releases through a trusted distributor can help 'cut through the noise'—editors receive many releases weekly, so provenance from a reputable source increases chance of notice and pickup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Security & Compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Deliver in a secure way: Cision demonstrates security protocols such as SOC 2 Type II compliance, single-sign-on, and multi-factor authentication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For regulated communications (e.g., investor relations) or sensitive announcements, prioritize distributors with verifiable security and compliance controls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry Expertise & Tailoring
rubrics_metrics.description: Get a team who knows your field, knows the major players and knows which newslines can help deliver the best results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage editorial and account teams familiar with your industry to target appropriate trades and outlets; tailor distribution strategy to the sector and audience for better relevance and pickup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Reach (national to international)
rubrics_metrics.description: From national to international, PR Newswire gets your story out in front of leaders and biggest influencers in print, broadcast and online, with support of international media experts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Decide whether your campaign needs local, national, or international push and use media-expert support to configure the appropriate reach and outlets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry/Subject Coding for Targeting
rubrics_metrics.description: Our staff of editors ensure each press release is coded for industry and subject trades that deliver your content to relevant, targeted audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accurate industry/subject coding increases the chance your release reaches relevant reporters and specialized publications—ensure metadata and categorization are correct.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guaranteed Paid Placement
rubrics_metrics.description: Amplify your story with guaranteed paid placement on premium websites. From industry-specific to custom campaigns, reach your target audience on their favourite sites.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use paid placement to secure visibility on premium sites when organic pickup is insufficient for campaign goals; tailor placements to audience preferences and industry verticals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia Inclusion to Boost Engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Press releases that include multimedia elements have up to six times higher engagement. Include videos, images, infographics and more to increase interest in your release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enhance releases with relevant multimedia to raise engagement metrics; choose assets that add context and storytelling value rather than decorative content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consultation & Strategic Support (24/7/365)
rubrics_metrics.description: From 24/7/365 editorial support to strategic account management, PR Newswire’s team of experts will help your team navigate the always-evolving media market, reach the right audiences and execute flawlessly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tap into round-the-clock editorial and strategic support for timing-sensitive announcements and to refine messaging and targeting; use account managers to align distribution strategy with business objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Platform Usability & Speed of Submission
rubrics_metrics.description: PR Newswire Amplify: submitting your press releases is fast, easy and intuitive for PR Newswire members. Get everything set up in a matter of clicks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose tools that streamline submission and workflow to reduce time-to-distribution; platform ease matters for last-minute or high-volume campaigns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proofreading & Editorial Quality Control
rubrics_metrics.description: One more step before it goes out: our 24/7/365 team of proofreaders and editors makes sure every T is crossed and every grammatical error caught.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use distributor editorial review to improve clarity and professionalism; ensure releases are proofread to avoid errors that harm credibility or reduce pickup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measurement & Analytics
rubrics_metrics.description: Easy-to-use performance metrics show you where it went, who saw it and what they did next. Our dashboards transform this data into intelligence that drives your business.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitor reach, views, engagement, and downstream actions via dashboards; use analytics to evaluate campaign ROI and refine future targeting and messaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multichannel News Release (MNR) Strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: A Multichannel News Release (MNR) is a distribution strategy that promotes your content to journalists and consumer audiences across multiple channels. All incoming traffic goes to the MNR landing page to provide more context for your message and encourage further engagement with your brand.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt a multichannel approach and centralize traffic on an MNR landing page to give visitors additional context and conversion opportunities; use the landing page to extend the story and capture interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience Targeting & Large Journalist/Influencer Database
rubrics_metrics.description: You are guaranteed to find the right audience with access to a database of over 1.1 billion journalists and influencers and state-of-the-art technology that makes it easy to quickly pinpoint journalists and influencers who wield power in your market.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage large, searchable media databases and targeting tools to identify high-impact contacts; segment lists by influence, beat, geography, and medium for precision outreach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specialized Solutions for Investor Relations and ESG
rubrics_metrics.description: Find tools for whatever you need: Investor Relations — Build shareholder interest and market confidence with secure regulatory compliance and IR solutions. Environmental, Social & Governance — Conquer the fragmented media landscape. Find the right people, hit the best publications, and get your message to the right people.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use specialized distribution products and compliance-focused workflows for IR announcements; for ESG communications, use targeted tactics and channels that reach stakeholders and sector-specific publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsiveness & Tailored Service
rubrics_metrics.description: Testimonial: the service was kind, helpful and open to working together to find the best solution tailored to Nosy Crow and the specific needs of the coronavirus book... arrange the release for the next morning, and get everything ready to go efficiently within working hours; this made for a stress–free and positive experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect and plan for responsive, tailored support for time-sensitive releases; work with vendor teams to customize timing, format, and targeting to campaign needs.
